rules.doc: A server that answered before has missed two checks in a row.
A responding server reports itself unhealthy (for example JetStream not current).
Servers in one cluster run different NATS versions.
The slow-consumer count went up in the last 5 minutes.
A server has more than 90% of max_connections in use.
A clustered JetStream server sees no meta leader, so streams can't be created or changed.
JetStream file storage is over 80% (warning) or 95% (critical) of a server or account limit.
